hexcasting.mishap.invalid_value.class.mo: an entity capable of receiving soul projection
hex_monitor.advice.monitor/set: By projecting a sliver of your soul into an entity within the same dimension, you may share that entity's vision. Only scrolls, allays, hex casters, and certain ethereal entities can serve as targets. Targeting yourself restores your normal sight. Consumes 5 amethyst dust. Curiously, when viewing through another caster's eyes, you cannot see your own body.
hex_monitor.advice.monitor/get: Obtains the entity into which the target player has projected their soul. If the target is viewing through their own body, the wrath of consciousness will be incurred.
hex_monitor.advice.monitor/def: Accepts an entity and returns the player iota of the one whose consciousness is invested within it.
hex_monitor.chat.looking: You feel a sudden chill for no apparent reason...
miehex_revolution.page.const/max: I push against the boundaries of the world itself, and find the greatest number that can be expressed within this reality. Returns the largest possible numerical value.
miehex_revolution.page.const/min: I dive to the deepest depths of negation, finding the smallest number this world can contain. Returns the smallest possible numerical value (the negation of the maximum).
miehex_revolution.page.page: By imbuing the spellbook in my offhand with a touch of will, I can flip through its pages without lifting a finger. Accepts a non-negative integer and rotates the spellbook's current page forward by that many pages. Requires a spellbook in the offhand.
miehex_revolution.page.loader/time: I anchor a region of space to the ticking of the world's heart, compelling it to remain loaded for a time. Accepts a position vector and a duration in ticks. The chunk containing the position will be kept loaded for the specified duration. Media cost scales with duration.
miehex_revolution.page.eval_in: I take a list and a sequence of patterns, then cast those patterns with the list's contents as the new stack. Returns whatever the patterns leave on the stack.
miehex_revolution.page.indexes: I search through a list for all elements that match a given form. Accepts a list and an iota. Returns a list of numbers — the zero-based indices of every element that equals the given iota.
miehex_revolution.page.use: I reach across the void and use a block with my other hand. Accepts a position vector. Uses the block itself at that location.
miehex_revolution.page.use_on: I channel my reach through the item held in my offhand. Accepts a position vector. Uses the item in the caster's offhand on the target block.
miehex_revolution.page.use_on/with: I draw two things from the aether and apply one to the block. Accepts a position vector and an item entity iota. Uses the given item on the target block.
miehex_revolution.page.idea/set: I construct a block from pure thought, allowing it to assume the appearance of other blocks. Accepts a position vector and manifests an Idea Block at that location. Once placed, right-click with any block to change its appearance; shift-right-click with an empty hand to reset it.
miehex_revolution.page.interact.1: I extend my reach across the void to interact with a distant entity. Accepts an entity and a boolean. If true, attacks the target; if false, right-clicks the target. Media cost grows exponentially with horizontal distance.
miehex_revolution.page.interact.2: This is a Great Spell. Its media cost is 2^(|Δx| + |Δz|), doubling for each block of horizontal offset. Equally useful for intimate conversation or remote retribution.
